verify.notes: V8629 own disasm: 1424288d7 xor edi,edi falls into 1424288d9 mov eax,edi; add rsp,0x430; pops rbx,rdi,rsi,r14,r15; ret. It is the target of jbe 857, je 865, je 876, je 886 (list index past array, null record, entrant unavailable) and returns 0 to the populate, whose test al,al at 1424284ce then sets the flag bits. A jump from 142428832 keeps rsp (sub rsp,0x430 only at entry, calls balanced) and the callee-saved registers are restored from the frame, so r14 never being loaded is harmless. It is a continue target only, nothing is patched there.
